gemini-android-side-panel-settings-redes.headline: Google redesigns the side panel and settings in the Gemini app for Android.

oneplus-oxygenos-to-coloros.headline: OnePlus phones move from OxygenOS to ColorOS with the stable Android 17 update.

apple-music-rebrand-2026.headline: Apple Music gets its first rebrand since launching in 2015, with a new logo made from sound.

apple-ios-27-2-selfie-age-verification.headline: iOS 27.2 adds age verification by selfie.

google-gemini-live-plus-menu-redesign.headline: Google redesigns the plus button in Gemini Live on Android to make adding photos and files easier.

google-photos-collections-tab-redesign.headline: Google Photos redesigns its Collections tab so users can customise it.

apple-macos-touch-macbook-pro.headline: Apple brings touch input to the Mac and publishes guidance for adapting apps to it.

chrome-suggested-by-gemini-autofill.headline: Chrome rolls out "Suggested by Gemini" autofill, which fills in more information on web forms.

microsoft-copilot-identity.headline: Microsoft gives Copilot a new identity that positions it as a work tool.

nytimes-175-identity.headline: The New York Times marks its 175th anniversary with a custom 175 mark and identity system.

youtube-google-tv-youtube-music-red-logo.headline: YouTube on Google TV starts showing YouTube Music with a red logo.

apple-music-android-liquid-glass.headline: Apple Music 7.0 for Android brings the Liquid Glass design and the new app icon.

google-messages-phone-contacts-gradient-.headline: Google is rolling out gradient app icons for Messages, Phone and Contacts.

x-ios-alternate-app-icons.headline: X replaces its alternative app icon set on iPhone and iPad with more than a dozen new options.

safari-vertical-tabs-adaptive-dark-mode.headline: Safari adds a Vertical Tabs layout and Adaptive Dark Mode in the iOS 27.3, iPadOS 27.3 and macOS 27.3 betas.

apple-health-app-redesign.headline: Apple's redesigned Health app returns in the iOS 27.3 beta, with new Insights and Longevity tabs.

apple-ios-standby-redesign-expansion.headline: iOS 27.3 brings the iPhone Duo's redesigned StandBy to iPhone 11 and newer.

apple-iphone-duo-reachability.headline: iOS 27.3 adds Reachability to the iPhone Duo for one-handed use.

tabby-identity-ragged-edge.headline: Middle Eastern fintech app Tabby gets a new identity from Ragged Edge.

swiss-post-custom-typeface.headline: Swiss Post gets a custom typeface from Swiss Typefaces.

apple-app-store-subscription-retention-m.headline: Apple adds retention messages to the App Store subscription cancellation flow.

apple-macos-live-activities-menu-bar.headline: macOS 27.3 shows Live Activities in the menu bar on Macs without a Dynamic Island.

google-android-family-hub-settings.headline: Google confirms a new Family Hub section in Android Settings.
